SRT HELLCAT® REDEYE //
Powered by a 797-horsepower, 707-lb-ft-of-torque
Supercharged 6.2L high-output HEMI® V8 engine mated
to a TorqueFlite® 8HP90 8-speed automatic transmission,
the SRT Hellcat Redeye model can run a quarter-mile in
FA M I LY O F
10.6 seconds at 129 mph, go from 0 – 60 in the mid-3-second
range and hit a top speed of 203 mph. Standard Torque
Reserve delivers up to 3.9 psi of boost at launch and up to
55 percent more engine torque. Both the steel prop shafts
and the half-shafts allow the vehicle to handle the additional
F U R Y torque created with the help of the SRT Power Chiller® and
After-Run Chiller. Essentially, this daily driver is a beast.
SRT HELLCAT //
Only slightly less raucous than its sibling, the Charger
SRT Hellcat model throws down serious performance
numbers of its own. Its 717-horsepower, 650-lb-ft-of-
torque performance is also supplied by a Supercharged
6.2L HEMI SRT Hellcat V8 engine. Its dominance shows
in 0 – 60 runs in 3.6 seconds and its impressive
10.96 quarter-mile elapsed time—even on street tires.
SRT® DRIVE MODES //
All SRT Hellcat trim levels feature Drive Modes specific
to the vehicle. The standard SRT Performance Pages
brings critical vehicle performance data to the driver’s
fingertips, while race options give the driver the ability
to access Launch Control, Shift Light and Line Lock.

ICONIC HEMI® ORANGE // Pay tribute to the original
Orange color of arguably the most iconic engine ever. Available
exclusively on the Charger GT Rear-Wheel Drive (RWD)
and Scat Pack Widebody trim levels, the available HEMI
Orange Package brings race-inspired style to your vehicle. A
sporty, offset Orange and Gunmetal stripe runs tip to tail for
maximum impact. Orange brake calipers are visible through
the spokes of the 20 by 11-inch Carbon Black Warp-Speed
aluminum wheels on Scat Pack models or 20 by 9-inch Mid-
Gloss Black aluminum wheels on GT models. The trim-level
badging with pops of Orange does the rest of the talking.
Inside, Desert Orange accent stitching gives a custom feel to
the instrument panel (IP), steering wheel, shifter boot, seats
and doors. K-Black and Gloss Black accents are found on the
three steering wheel bezels, the cluster trim, HVAC rings and
the shifter body. An Orange-accented “392” IP badge also
sets this package apart.
